Theorem
[Seifert--van Kampen] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0203 1. ch31:31.22\group 3-manifold topology

For a union $X=X_1\cup X_2$ with path-connected intersection, $\pi _1(X)$ is the free product of $\pi _1(X_1)$ and $\pi _1(X_2)$ modulo the normal subgroup identifying the two inclusion images. If both maps from the intersection are injective, the maps from the pieces are injective.
